run_MemoryProfile: run MemoryProfile on a _ProfilerResult to analyze tensor memory allocation and category classification
run_MemoryProfileTimeline: run MemoryProfileTimeline on a memory profile to generate memory timeline data and export formats
export_memory_timeline_html: export memory timeline as an HTML file with embedded PNG plot showing GPU memory usage by category
export_memory_timeline: export memory timeline as a JSON file with timestamps and sizes by category for a given device
export_memory_timeline_raw: export memory timeline as raw event tuples in JSON format with timestamp, action, numbytes, and category
